source.label: Card Titan: 2018 NA Vintage Championship Top 8 (Profiles)

notes.text: Seeds and the player count (381) are from Card Titan's standings after round 10, the final Swiss round.

Placings are from Eternal Central's coverage, which prints the seeded Top 8 bracket: quarterfinals Coval (1) def. Kwok (8), Shay (7) def. Sperling (2), Tran (3) def. Arthurs (6), Dorgan (4) def. Burk (5); semifinals Coval def. Dorgan, Tran def. Shay; final Coval def. Tran. Card Titan lists the Top 8 in seed order without results, and mtgtop8 copied that order, which made Sperling the finalist and left Shay in 5-8.
Card Titan misspells two players in places ("Nam Tram" in a profile, "Como Kwok" on a decklist); the standings have Tran and Kwok.
